description: Synthetic single-region world aggregate used only for M2 mechanics and provisional calibration. Not a historical country or a source-verified population series.
notes: The initial total (1,621,287,278) is the January 1, 1900 interpolation of the OWID long-run world-population series (1899/1900 mid-year values). The 17-band age distribution is a provisional stylized distribution, not source-verified. The GDD provisional 1.65B anchor is about 1.7% above this source-derived year-start value; the discrepancy is documented in source_notes.md.
